sources.notes: Verified 2026-09-25: HTTP 200 application/vnd.api+json via plain fetch (honest UA) with the Accept header; square brackets are percent-encoded so system curl needs no -g. This backend flattens attributes to item level (title, created, path.alias, drupal_internal__nid). LINK CAVEAT: the public site www.bcm.mr is a React SPA whose article route is /actualite/<uuid>/<alias> and BOTH segments are required (Playwright test 2026-09-25: /actualite/<uuid> alone renders the SPA 404 page, /actualite/<uuid>/<alias> renders the article); the api map can only prefix one field, bo.bcm.mr node pages are WAF-blocked (HTTP 500 URL blocked), so url = the item JSON:API self link (unique, dereferenceable, carries id + path.alias + title). Editors build the page link as https://www.bcm.mr/actualite/<id>/<path.alias>; a url template in lib/api.mjs would remove this caveat. The feed mixes reports (Lettre d information, Rapport annuel, Cahiers d etudes) with meetings and greetings, hence only_reports: true. Sister feeds on the same backend: node/revue_economique (Cahiers d etudes), media/document (see bcm-documents-jsonapi). Keep to one request per day.
